scope: Full-group Linux archive codec and accepted-owner snapshot; storage/file-only qualification, no group transport or runtime Apply

contract.format: LCGROUP1 magic, u32LE header length, SHA256 header, strict JSON and sequential typed payloads. LCPROF01 remains a separate named-slot format. Shared stage/read/validate/publish/remap helpers. No Windows ZIP interoperability.
contract.screen_scope: Active theme/cached pages or media, all screen slots, gallery-only references and complete managed user image/video upload catalog, including files absent from membership. Shared typed keys deduplicated; font bytes and names retained. FanAndLighting carries no screen payload.
contract.defaults: Protected versioned gallery defaults retain canonical bundled identities, without extra imported members. Theme references to builtins still carry payloads and get remapped. This preserves full256-entry gallery acceptance.
contract.limits: Header<=1MiB,1024 typed entries,8GiB payload,64KiB copy buffer. Image/font<=16MiB, normalized image<=960x960, existing per-media limits. Fonts<=64MiB per theme including cached pages, not aggregate over all slots. Two48MiB themes budget case is manifest-only, no96MiB actual font upload claimed.
contract.atomicity: All source payloads and post-remap shape validated before any managed asset publication. Preparation alone does not change settings/slots. Pins retained through PreparedGroup lifetime; fonts use session retention. Post-validation IO failures may leave valid unreferenced assets; caller still must coordinate commit/runtime. Atomic file export never overwrites existing destination.
contract.catalog: Shared legacy membership rules with PreparedMigration. Image/media inventories captured/rechecked under short locks; writer/copy never runs while catalog locks are held.
contract.owner: ReadProfileGroup runs blocking snapshot from accepted latest settings sequentially with queued deltas; preserves dirty status and no implicit flush. Commit messages/receipt/runtime are still pending.

coverage: Actual clean-store file roundtrip and atomic settings/slots restore, active/cached theme, gallery-only and unlisted uploads, shared font exact bytes, names, sensor/text identity, fresh store restart and re-export.
Legacy catalog materialization using shared migration rules.
Actual256-entry gallery imports without duplicate protected defaults.
Missing/truncated/corrupt/duplicate/extra/unsafe manifest inputs publish no managed assets or settings.
Recomputed valid checksums cannot bypass image/font validation or malformed final H264 access unit. This checks container/index/Annex-B, not pixel decode or hardware playback.
FanAndLighting carries no screen uploads; no-overwrite publication; failed export leaves destination absent; raw writer errors propagate.
Indexed600-frame/>1MiB upload copied with64KiB requests/writes; final access unit actually read after preparation.
Prepared image/media pins block deletion before owner commit/drop and release on drop.
Manifest-only per-theme font budgets accept96MiB across two48MiB themes, reject96MiB single theme; absent payloads never pass preparation.
Actual async settings owner snapshot includes queued fan/LCD deltas, retains dirty state, no profile mutation; shutdown saves accepted changes.

slot_regression.note: Original slot archive storage tests also pass inside final workspace; current workspace includes existing CLI/IPC/native-job Rust regressions.

checks.gui_native: NOT RUN: frontend unchanged; group IPC/CLI/GUI not implemented
checks.hardware: NOT RUN: user deferred; private file stores and existing MockBackend tests only

remaining: Owner commit with PreparedGroup pins and durable operation receipt, lost-reply/restart/current-state recovery
Atomic runtime preparation/reconciliation for LCD/cooling/RGB and failure/sleep/detach/shutdown behavior
Group IPC/CLI/native GUI transfer and expanded browser/native/accessibility/fault matrix
Windows ZIP type/version/profile/assets mapping and interoperability
Hardware acceptance deferred and additional LCD effects/Style Express last
